versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "paper-summary-scripted" skill.
- Supports deterministic preprocessing of arXiv PDF URLs or local paper files before summarization.
- Runs a four-stage workflow: summary generation, detailed version, contribution extraction, and a final consistency/quality check.
- Uses a bundled script to ensure text extraction and cleaning before generation.
- Strictly avoids web page/HTML parsing; only works with PDFs.
- Provides robust error handling and manifest awareness for incomplete or failed extractions.
